criteria.evidence: ci-results.json: AC-035 exitCode 0, lastLine 'AC-035 OK' (mechanical checks satisfied). Static review: test/integration/fake-cli.test.mjs:82-96 and 140-143 assert timers.size===0 but never assert that the timed-out child process has exited or that children.size===0; the trackedSpawn fallback kill (33-38) and finally kill mask a failed termination. acceptance.md/design.md require no leftover processes and cleanup after process exit. Also test/helpers/fake-cli.mjs:8,16 copies the full runtime into each of 72 instances, contradicting design.md 'shared runtime script, avoid 72 copies'.

findings.summary: timeout case does not assert the child process exited / no leftover children; fallback kills mask cleanup failure
